checks.description: Which checks to run; default both.

image.description: Serving image to probe. Required when probe is requested.

fix.description: Let preflight create the namespace and install GAIE CRDs.

selector.description: Pod labels of an adopted fleet. When present the probe runs inside one matching pod (`deploy probe --selector`) instead of a Job, because the fleet already holds the chips and the running pod is the image under study.

sim.description: The recipe's engine_flavor is sim: preflight reports missing TPU nodes as a warning, and the probe declares the simulator's capabilities instead of running.

recipe_path.description: The serving recipe the study will deploy. Preflight then also checks what it needs on the cluster: the weights PVCs its pod mounts and the Secret its source clone reads.

stage_weights.description: When preflight finds a weights claim missing and the request allows it, stage it with `deploy stage-weights` (hf download into the hub layout). Absent = report the gap, stage nothing.

ro_via_snapshot.description: VolumeSnapshotClass: populate <pvc>-rw, snapshot, clone the claim ReadOnlyMany (Hyperdisk ML layout).

from_snapshot.description: An existing populated VolumeSnapshot to clone instead of downloading.

tolerate_tpu.description: Run the download Job on a TPU node (some disk classes attach only there).

wait.description: Block until populated (default true; a 400 GB checkpoint takes hours).

examples.prompt: Verify the cluster and image for the study.
